questions.question: The instrument _________ is used for detecting electric current is
questions.questionHtml: The instrument _________ is used for detecting electric current is
questions.solution: A galvanometer is an instrument used to detect the presence of electric current in a circuit. It measures both the direction and magnitude of small currents or voltages. Unlike an ammeter, it is primarily used in null detection in circuits such as bridges and potentiometers.

questions.question: Who is regarded as the "father of the atomic bomb"?
questions.questionHtml: Who is regarded as the "father of the atomic bomb"?
questions.solution: J. Robert Oppenheimer was an American theoretical physicist who is regarded as the "father of the atomic bomb". He is credited for his role in the Manhattan Project – the World War II undertaking that developed the first nuclear weapons. In August 1945, the weapons were used in the atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

questions.question: Which of the following was the first military communication satellite developed by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following was the first military communication satellite developed by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Rukmini.

Key Points

  •  Rukmini satellite:
    • It is also known as GSAT-7.
    • It was launched on Aug 30, 2013.
    • It was launched by Ariane 5 ECA rocket from Kourou in French Guiana.
    • It was the first military communication satellite developed by the ISRO for the Indian Defence forces, with the Indian Navy being the primary user.
    • It is an advanced communication satellite built by ISRO to provide a wide range of service spectrum from low-bit rate voice to high-bit-rate data communication.
    • Its payload is designed to provide communication capabilities to users over a wide oceanic region including the Indian land-mass.​​

Additional Information

  • Aryabhata
    • It was India's first satellite.
    • It was launched in 1975.
  • Rohini RS-1
    • It was India's first indigenous satellite launch that was used for measuring the in-flight performance of the second experimental launch of SLV-3.
    • It was launched in 1980.
  • ​Apple
    • It was the first experimental communication satellite.
    • It was launched in 1981.

questions.question: The first Indian Communication satellite is
questions.solution: Ariane Passenger Payload Experiment (APPLE): It was an experimental communication satellite successfully launched by Ariane-1, from French Guiana on June 19, 1981. It was India's first communication satellite. The satellite provided experience in building and operating a payload experiment three-axis stabilized communication satellite.

questions.question: In which year Google search engine was launched?
questions.questionHtml: In which year Google search engine was launched?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is ​1998.

Key Points

  • The Google story begins in 1995 at Stanford University, with Larry Page and Sergey Brin.
  • In August 1998, Google was officially launched.
  •  More than 70% of worldwide online search requests are handled by Google.
  • Current CEO: Sundar Pichai.
  • The browser developed by Google is Chrome.

questions.solution: Thomas Alva Edison was an American scientist and regarded as America's greatest inventor. He invented the phonograph, dictaphone, electric lamp, autographic printer, etc. He established the first industrial research laboratory.

questions.question: Which among the following are India's permanent and operational research stations in Antarctica?
questions.questionHtml: Which among the following are India's permanent and operational research stations in Antarctica?
questions.solution: India's permanent and operational research stations in Antarctica are Bharati and Maitri. Dakshin Gangotri was India's first station but is no longer operational; it now serves as a supply base. Bharati focuses on earth sciences, and Maitri supports ongoing scientific research in climate and glaciology.

questions.question: Which branch of physics deals with properties of fluids at rest?
questions.questionHtml: Which branch of physics deals with properties of fluids at rest?
questions.solution: Hydrostatics is the branch of physics that deals with the properties of fluids at rest. It particularly deals with the pressure in a fluid or exerted by a fluid (gas or liquid) on an immersed body. It also deals with Archimedes’ principle and the equilibrium of floating bodies.

questions.question: Which scientist/s proposed the theory of relativity?
questions.questionHtml: Which scientist/s proposed the theory of relativity?
questions.solution:
• Relativity is a theorem, formulated by Albert Einstein.
  • It states that space and time are relative and all the motion must be relative to a frame of reference.
  • It is a notion that states, laws of physics are the same everywhere. This theory is simple but hard to understand.
  • It states:
    • There is no absolute reference frame on can measure velocity if the object or momentum is only in relation to other objects.
    • The speed of light is constant irrespective of who measures it or how fast the person measuring it, is moving.

questions.question: In which year was the computer reservation system started by the Indian Railways?
questions.questionHtml: In which year was the computer reservation system started by the Indian Railways?
questions.solution: The computer reservation system was started by the Indian Railways in 1986. This system enabled efficient booking and management of railway reservations, marking a significant technological advancement in the railway sector.
